questions.question: S1: A synthetic client reads task-owned fixture updates from a scratch server and displays a simple status indicator. Which isolated validation path should this harmless probe use?

options.label: Keep synthetic updates (Recommended)
options.description: The scratch client announces a simple test capability at its local handshake and receives synthetic status transitions. Clients without the test marker keep fixture updates through the existing adapter. The adapter stays confined to this task-owned probe and never affects a user session. Machines go first; synthetic sessions follow after this screen geometry has been captured.

options.label: Use a fresh fixture
options.description: The scratch server tells only this synthetic client to load another harmless text fixture before status is shown. This alternative changes no account setting, authentication profile, persistent rule, or existing user session and is included only to occupy the native description rows.

options.label: Defer the scratch check
options.description: Keep the synthetic fixture unchanged. Capture the current native prompt and continue only after the parser owner provides the current-source fix.

questions.question: S2: The synthetic probe displays a task-owned status marker after receiving a harmless fixture update. Which timing choice should this isolated scratch validation record?

options.label: Record the first marker
options.description: Observe only the synthetic marker and retain the task-owned capture so the exact native answer can be checked against the structured hook result.

options.label: Record the next marker
options.description: Observe the subsequent harmless marker in the same isolated fixture without changing any persistent preference or touching another runtime.

questions.question: S3: The synthetic probe has captured its harmless fixture and status marker. Which final summary should this task-owned validation keep for the native multi-question review?

options.label: Keep the captured result
options.description: Preserve the public synthetic capture and exact structured answers for the current-source validation report, then stop only this task-owned runtime.

options.label: Keep a short summary
options.description: Keep only a brief task-owned summary of the fixture result, with no account, credential, policy, server, or user-session changes.
